summary: The sole occurrence is the exact inherited Preterit example at 60/67. Its proposed thin-cell addition would duplicate the same full sentence, so no new example or sense is added.

The vizier is the enriching agent and u faqiro is the fronted affected person. maġnele is causative III, not an intransitive becoming-rich predicate; the purchase payment explains the resulting wealth.
The source supports only the inherited ordinary enrichment meaning. It supplies no new government, idiom, Detransitive use or paradigm form.
